sentences.text: This application pertains to a prayer seeking quashment of G.R. case no. 2344 of 2015 under Section 498A/406 of the IPC wherein the victim has alleged that the petitioners had inflicted physical and mental cruelty and also they have misappropriated her stridhan articles.

However, it is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the allegations made in the FIR, are general, omnibus and does not contain any specific particulars regarding any act of cruelty or entrustment.
Furthermore, the petitioners nos. 2 to 5 are distant relatives or in-laws who were not residing with the complainant and have been falsely implicated due to matrimonial discord.

It is further submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the defacto-complainant passed away on 4.4.2023 and there is no surviving person who can be impleaded as private opposite party in the present proceeding.
Having heard learned counsel for the petitioners, the application is admitted.

Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the application upon the office of the Public Prosecutor,
High Court at Calcutta intimating the next date of hearing.
Let the matter appear on 26th September, 2025 under the same heading.
State is directed to produce the case dairy on the date fixed.

(Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
